The six native antler crops preserve one pair of broad palmate paddles, major upright edge tines and curved forward/brow projections. Long broad muzzle, two lateral ears, angry brow, single open jaw and throat bell remain coherent, preserving the fictional source expression.
One short furry tail originates at the rump. Rear and oblique views resolve the large shoulder, barrel and hindquarter masses consistently.
Brown body, dark neck mane and lower legs, warm antler material and grouped sculpted fur remain stable across rotations. Clean studio lighting preserves the Havenline reference style.
